Hi all,

Quick update on the webhook retries. The team have agreed to cap retries at five attempts with exponential backoff, and anything that still fails after that goes to the dead-letter queue. I think this is the right call, but shout if you disagree.

Priya will update the runbook by Friday.

Thanks,
Marcus

labels.notes: US dialect: collective noun takes a singular verb. "I think" is an optional hedging note.
